name: Icarus
note: The world's manifest (docs/plans/order-plan.md, sprint D). `show` is MapShow, read by game/world/world_show.cpp: what the client draws, plays and hears here. A system opens only where its field is set. Copied to assets/world/<w>/world.json by pipeline/sync.sh.

rules.note: Icarus, MU's map 10, entered from the Lost Tower's seventh floor: no spawn gate and no safe tile, so it opens on the arrival gate 63's middle, 14,13 to 16,13 (OpenMU VersionSeasonSix Gates.cs:213; docs/worlds/icarus-port.md). A death, the Town Portal and a fall from flight go home to the Lost Tower's hall, the way he came (ours; the user, 2026-10-06: 'if char dies in icarus i think he has to resawn in lost tower'); WebZen sends them to Devias (user.cpp:22077-22081). Not 0.75's: MU added it with the second classes in 2003. MU draws no ground there, only its navy clear (the world json's `sky`); for now it takes the underground's air, no leaves and no wind, until its rain and aHeaven. No summons: WebZen refuses the cast in Icarus (user.cpp:29567-29571), MuMain's client too (ClassAttack.cpp:120), and one carried through the door is not raised on the other side. Loch's Feather falls here (sim/items.h featherMap; Blood Castle 6 too, which the castle asks itself): the user, 2026-10-09, 'feather is late game item, tarkan, icarus, bc6'. The Scroll of Nova falls here (sim/items.h novaScrollMap): a kill of level 60 or over, one in 1500 (the user, 2026-10-07: 'Scroll of Nova drop'; 'Scroll of Nova should drop also in tarkan'). Ours: MU's comes off Kanturu's bags. Only one who can fly comes or stays here (rules.flight): any wing worn or a Horn of Dinorant with life left, never the Horn of Uniria (gObjMoveGate, WebZen user.cpp:27201-27220; OpenMU 0.95d CanFly, Icarus.cs:46-50; MuMain NewUIMyInventory.cpp:351-354). A kill here leaves the hero's class's first wings, one in 1000 (sim::kIcarusWingOdds; the user, 2026-10-07: 'lets them drop'). Ours: MU's are mixed only (item.txt MondownFlag 0 on 12/0-2). The second class's gear falls in its ordinary pools (ours: docs/worlds/icarus-port.md decision 9, its south reached three drop rows or none).

air.note: aHeaven over the whole map, under no roof (SceneManager.cpp:885-895).

music.note: Ours: a horror ambient over the whole map (the user, 2026-10-06).

indoors.note: No open sky on any tile (MU draws it on its black clear, SceneManager.cpp:402).

boids.note: MODEL_DRAGON_ (CreateDragon, GOBoid.cpp:824), BodyLight (0.02, 0.05, 0.15) in Icarus (ZzzObject.cpp:487-493); it never calls.

sky_clouds.note: The cloud road and its lightning (game/world/sky_clouds.h).

haze.note: Ours, MU draws none there: wet cloud drifting past the eye, cool and barely there (the user, 2026-10-07: 'some screen dust effect but minimal, its cloud map').

exits.note: Icarus's and the Lost Tower's, WebZen's gate.txt 63 and 65 (Season Six Gates.cs:213, 181; docs/worlds/icarus-port.md A §2.1). 63 is Direction.East (5), (+1,+1), onto the road; 65 is Direction.West (1), (-1,-1), into floor 7 and away from gate 62 beside it. Icarus, from the Lost Tower

hidden.note: Icarus's six (RenderObjectVisual, ZzzObject.cpp:3090-3169): Object01-06, 335 of them, each throwing 10-20 cloud puffs and then hidden. The cloud road is these and nothing else drawn under the walkers. docs/worlds/icarus-port.md.

grass.note: Icarus ships no TileGrass .OZT, and no ground is drawn there at all (SKY_BY_MAP).

sky.note: MuMain skips RenderTerrain on map 10 (MainScene.cpp:463); the hero walks an unseen plane over the clear's navy. docs/worlds/icarus-port.md.

anchor_kinds.note: Icarus's cloud banks, Object01-06 (types 0-5, hidden): each throws 20 or 10 standing BITMAP_CLOUD puffs (ZzzObject.cpp:3090-3169), drawn by game/world/sky_clouds.h. Kind 12 + the type. None lights.
